title: 第13章 楚家一分为二第14章 大戏将起野心疯狂
slug: 朝廷鹰犬没挨过六扇门的刀
content_zh:
楚家，一分为二。
时间过得很快，对於李君肃来说是这样。
夜晚，李家，宴厅。
“如何了？”李君肃看着喜笑颜开的李长春，无奈的开口。
这家伙真的是，从自己坐下开始就一副二少爷，你来问问我的样子，给李君肃搞无语了。
“二少爷，这楚夷的名声算是响彻这城郊了，而且这楚夷啊也如您所料，把林家原来的宅子给占了。”李长春兴奋的说道。
这种背後操控一切的感觉实在是让他爽到不行。
“嗯，然後呢？”李君肃看着兴奋的李长春，慢条斯理的吃着饭。
“在林家守着的楚家戍卫听完事情经过後，戍卫的头头立马就离开了城郊，回矿山去了。”李长春接着汇报。
“倒是聪明人，接下来的舞台都是这楚家两兄弟的了。”李君肃闻言点了点头。
“还有呢二少爷，接下来才是劲爆的地方。”李长春摆了摆手。
“嗯，你说。”李君肃看着激动的李长春，淡定的应着。
“楚家里有一半的佣人知道这事後都跑到林家去了，而且那些百姓怕楚大力暗杀楚夷，现在都在林家大宅外轮流守夜呢！”李长春说着说着，自己都笑了起来。
“不过这楚夷也是聪明人，现在一直都在跟那些百姓待在一起，就是不知道他的银两够不够，吃喝可是很花钱的。”李长春笑着开口。
“接下来就等楚家那边来人了。”李君肃闻言点了点头。
“吃饭。”李君肃指了指面前的饭菜。
“好嘞少爷。”李长春连忙说道。
“是二少爷。”李君肃耐心的纠正。
“都一样了少爷，老是叫二少爷拗口。”李长春笑嘻嘻的开口。
这话给李君肃整无语了，他怎麽不知道二少爷这个词拗口。

“尊卑有序。”而後，李君肃有些严肃的说。
“我知道了，没人的时候就不用那麽麻烦了吧。”李长春先是严肃的应下，而後嬉皮笑脸的应着。
“”李君肃看着嬉皮笑脸的李长春摇了摇头，而後自己吃着饭。
“怎麽一个个都跟意姐一样，是我太好说话了吗？”李君肃有些无奈的想着。
回忆。
“我才不管，就叫你君肃，又没有别人。”
“我不管！抱抱怎麽了？我们小时候天天抱抱呢。”李君意看着李君肃，开始耍无赖。
“才没有意姐！”李君肃有些恼怒的反驳。
他本质上还是个大人，怎麽可能天天跟李君意抱抱，明明是她每次都能从後面偷袭到自己。
“果然，长大了就不可爱了。”李君意也是脾气上来了，揉着李君肃的脸蛋嘀咕着。
“唔！”李君肃感受着自己脸颊被搓圆捏扁的感觉，挥着手抗议道。
“少爷，想什麽呢？”李长春看着李君肃脸上温柔的笑意，好奇的眨了眨眼睛。
“没有，吃你的饭。”回过神的李君肃看着好奇的李长春，挑了挑眉。
李家依旧平平淡淡的，祥和又安宁，但另一边可不是这麽个画风。

The Chu family was divided into two.
Time flies by quickly, for Li Junsu.
Night, Li family, banquet hall.
"What's wrong?" Li Junsu looked at the smiling Li Changchun and said helplessly.
This guy really acted like the second young master from the moment he sat down, you come and ask me, which made Li Junsu speechless.
"Second Young Master, Chu Yi's reputation has spread throughout the suburbs, and as you expected, Chu Yi has taken over the Lin family's original residence." Li Changchun said excitedly.
This feeling of controlling everything from behind really made him extremely happy.
"Well, what happens next?" Li Junsu looked at the excited Li Changchun and ate his meal slowly.
"After the Chu family's garrison guarding the Lin family heard what happened, the leader of the garrison immediately left the suburbs and returned to the mines." Li Changchun continued to report.
"You're a smart man. The next stage belongs to the two brothers of the Chu family." Li Junsu nodded after hearing this.
"And the second young master, the exciting part comes next." Li Changchun waved his hand.
"Well, tell me." Li Junsu looked at the excited Li Changchun and responded calmly.
"Half of the servants in the Chu family ran to the Lin family after knowing this. Moreover, those people were afraid that Chu would vigorously assassinate Chu Yi, so they were now taking turns keeping vigil outside the Lin family's mansion!" Li Changchun laughed as he spoke.
"But this Chu Yi is also a smart man. He has been staying with the people now. I just don't know if he has enough money. Food and drink are very expensive." Li Changchun said with a smile.
"Then we'll wait for someone from the Chu family to come." Li Junsu nodded after hearing this.
"Eat." Li Junsu pointed to the food in front of him.
"Okay, young master." Li Changchun said quickly.
"It's the second young master." Li Junsu corrected patiently.
"It's the same young master, I always call the second young master hard to talk." Li Changchun said with a smile.
Li Jun was speechless at these words. Why didn't he know that the word "Second Young Master" was hard to pronounce?
"There is order between superiority and inferiority." Then, Li Junsu said seriously.
"I understand. You don't need to go to so much trouble when there is no one around." Li Changchun responded seriously at first, and then responded with a playful smile.
"" Li Junsu looked at the playful Li Changchun and shook his head, then ate his meal.
"Why are all of them like Sister Yi? Am I too easy to talk to?" Li Junsu thought helplessly.
remember.
"I don't care. I'll just call you Jun Su. There's no one else."
"I don't care! What happened to the hug? We hugged every day when we were little." Li Junyi looked at Li Junsu and started to act rogue.
"I don't mean it, sister!" Li Junsu retorted with some annoyance.
He is still an adult at heart. How can he hug Li Junyi every day? It is obvious that she can sneak up on him from behind every time.
"Sure enough, she won't be cute when she grows up." Li Junyi also lost his temper, rubbing Li Junsu's face and muttering.
"No!" Li Junsu felt the feeling of his cheeks being rounded and pinched, and waved his hands in protest.
"Master, what are you thinking about?" Li Changchun looked at the gentle smile on Li Junsu's face and blinked curiously.
"No, just eat your food." Li Junsu, who had come back to his senses, looked at the curious Li Changchun and raised his eyebrows.
The Li family is still ordinary, peaceful and peaceful, but the other side is not like that.
